name: Websites
title: A website that represents the business behind it.
lead: We design and build business websites with a clear story, a considered visual identity and a useful path from first visit to enquiry, booking or purchase.
audience: For small businesses, established companies and product teams launching a new site or replacing one that no longer fits.
result: A complete website, tested across the agreed pages and customer journeys, with the access and documentation your team needs to manage it.

sections.title: Structure and copy
sections.body: Page planning, navigation, service and product explanations, relevant calls to action and copy grounded in your business. We map the questions a visitor needs answered before they contact you.

sections.title: Brand and interface
sections.body: A responsive design system with deliberate typography, imagery and page layouts. We can implement your existing identity or scope a new brand kit alongside the website.

sections.title: Pages and publishing
sections.body: Marketing pages, About, Product, Solutions, Resources, Blog, Contact and supplied legal content. Content management and publishing workflows are selected around your team's needs.

sections.title: Connected customer journeys
sections.body: Enquiries, booking systems, CRM connections, email capture and third-party APIs where required. Each integration has a defined purpose and a tested success and failure path.

sections.title: Launch and handover
sections.body: Domain connection, technical SEO foundations, responsive checks, accessibility review, performance work and deployment. Your team receives the agreed files, accounts and documentation.

packages.title: New website or complete rebuild
packages.body: Design and development for an agreed page inventory and customer journey.

packages.title: Repair an existing website
packages.body: A scoped Unslop engagement when the foundation is worth keeping.

process: Review the business, content and existing site.
Agree the pages, design direction and connected workflows.
Build and review the real content at desktop and mobile sizes.
Test, launch and hand over access and documentation.
inputs: Your current URL, brand assets, page requirements, approved business facts, system access and a decision-maker for feedback.
boundary: Page count, content production, CMS, integrations and migration are defined in the proposal. Hosting, paid fonts, stock licenses and ongoing maintenance are identified separately.

name: Ecommerce
title: Your brand, storefront and store operations. Built together.
lead: From product labels to Shopify setup, we connect the way your brand looks with the way customers shop and your team runs the store.
audience: For brands launching a store, merchants migrating platforms, and established stores improving their buying experience or operations.
result: A branded storefront with the agreed catalog, buying journeys, integrations and operating workflows ready for your team to use.

sections.title: Brand and product launch
sections.body: Brand creation, custom brand kits, product label design and implementation. Packaging is prepared against supplied specifications and approved product information; specialist regulatory review remains a separate responsibility.

sections.title: Shopify foundations
sections.body: Store setup, domain connection, product and collection creation, inventory setup, SEO foundations, pixel installation and supplied legal pages. We agree catalog size, variants, markets and data quality before quoting.

sections.title: The complete storefront
sections.body: Homepage, collection and product pages, About the Brand, FAQs, customer accounts and order-tracking pages. Product widgets, promotions, discount popups, subscriptions and upsells are configured to suit the offer and platform.

sections.title: Data and marketing connections
sections.body: Product and inventory data ingestion, plus consent-aware email and SMS data flows. Integrations can include Mailchimp, Klaviyo, Shopify Collabs, TikTok Shop and other supported sales and performance tools.

sections.title: Performance and conversion work
sections.body: Site-speed improvements, advanced upsells, expanded FAQs, quizzes and product discovery. We test important buying journeys and make measurement useful without promising a revenue uplift.

sections.title: Migration and connected operations
sections.body: Catalog and content migration, B2B ordering and agreed links to fulfillment, inventory or other business systems. Existing customers and orders require a specific migration and reconciliation plan.

sections.title: Platform eligibility
sections.body: Sales-channel access, subscriptions, checkout customization and advertising connections depend on plan, region and account approval. ChatGPT ads and emerging channels are scoped only after current merchant access and a supported integration path are confirmed.

packages.title: Store launch
packages.body: A new store from catalog and brand inputs through launch checks.

packages.title: Migration or B2B ordering
packages.body: A defined platform transition or wholesale ordering workflow.

packages.title: Brand and product launch
packages.body: Identity, product labels and launch-ready brand assets.

packages.title: Storefront buildout
packages.body: An agreed set of shopping pages and customer experiences.

packages.title: Commerce data and integrations
packages.body: Connect catalog, inventory, email, SMS and business systems.

packages.title: Sales-channel connections
packages.body: Configure eligible third-party channels and test the connection.

packages.title: Store improvement sprint
packages.body: Repair or improve a specific buying or operating journey.

process: Review the catalog, brand, platform and operational requirements.
Agree storefront layouts, data mappings and order scenarios.
Build the store and configure the agreed integrations.
Run test orders, verify data and hand over store operations.
inputs: Product data, prices, inventory, brand assets, approved policies, shipping and returns rules, platform access and marketing-consent requirements.
boundary: Platform plans, payment fees, apps, media spend, printing and ongoing store operation are separate unless expressly included. Legal pages use owner-approved content; implementation is not legal certification.

name: Software
title: The website. The application. The tools to run it.
lead: We build complete software products: the public website, customer experience, product features and owner dashboard, with frontend and backend deployment and a clear handover.
audience: For founders, product teams and businesses commissioning B2B or B2C software, a custom application, or a replacement for a workflow that no longer fits.
result: One coherent product with an agreed feature scope. You own the commissioned code, deployment and data, with optional support after handover.

sections.title: The public product website
sections.body: Branded marketing pages for the product, solutions, resources, blog, About, Contact and approved legal content. Genuine testimonials and relevant calls to action connect the website to the application.

sections.title: Accounts and customer experience
sections.body: Custom account setup, onboarding, the product dashboard, profile and settings. We design the customer journey around the product's actual features, roles and data.

sections.title: The application itself
sections.body: Booking systems, CRMs, social and community platforms, B2B and B2C applications, internal tools and Web3 products. We agree the product-specific capabilities and acceptance scenarios before development.

sections.title: The owner's dashboard
sections.body: Authorized user management, refund operations, financial visibility and other agreed administrative tools. Roles and access are enforced around the operations each person is allowed to perform.

sections.title: Data and integrations
sections.body: Custom databases, third-party data APIs, email, custom APIs and MCP interfaces where needed. Data ownership, vendor dependencies and operating costs are documented.

sections.title: Deployment and ownership
sections.body: Frontend and backend deployment assistance, source code, configuration guidance and a practical handover. Your accounts and data remain yours. Payment milestones, commissioned IP transfer and third-party licenses are stated in the agreement.

packages.title: Complete software product
packages.body: The public site, customer application, admin tools, integrations and deployment in one scoped engagement.

packages.title: One working business workflow
packages.body: A focused implementation connecting a specific task and its systems.

packages.title: Product prototype
packages.body: A representative vertical slice to test a product decision before a larger build.

packages.title: Booking systems
packages.body: Scheduling, availability and the booking exceptions your business needs.

packages.title: CRM build or extension
packages.body: Customer records, workflows and integrations around your operating process.

packages.title: Social and community products
packages.body: A scoped pilot or complete product with accounts, interactions and moderation requirements.

packages.title: Web3 implementation
packages.body: Begin with a bounded integration or prototype; production transactions require additional security and operational scope.

packages.title: Custom API
packages.body: A documented interface connecting your product, data and other systems.

process: Define the users, business model, permissions and required product journeys.
Review the brand, architecture, interface and representative working slice.
Build and test customer, admin and integration behavior.
Deploy the frontend and backend, transfer the agreed assets and document operations.
inputs: Product goals, priority features, user roles, existing data, provider accounts, approved business content and an owner for acceptance decisions.
boundary: Feature scope, integrations, data volumes and acceptance tests determine the project. A prototype is not a complete production product. Hosting, vendor usage and optional retainers are separate; ownership does not require an ongoing retainer.

name: Custom AI agents
title: An agent built for the work you actually do.
lead: Outreach, personal assistance, coding, financial analysis and agents inside your applications. We build the agent around the task, connect your tools and give you a way to inspect its work.
audience: For teams applying AI to an existing operation, adding agents to software, or establishing a managed environment for individual agents and teams.
result: A scoped agent or workflow with connected tools, relevant context, operating boundaries and an inspected handover. We are an anti-slop agency: the design and output must hold up to review.

sections.title: Outreach agents
sections.body: Research prospects from approved sources, prepare personalized outreach, route replies and update your CRM. Sending permissions, approved channels and review steps are defined with your team.

sections.title: Personal assistants
sections.body: Connect the documents, calendar, email and business tools you choose. Give the assistant useful context and clear permission to prepare, recommend or carry out specific tasks.

sections.title: Custom coding agents
sections.body: Configure repository context, development tools, test commands and review workflows around your codebase. Build a repeatable path from task to checked change.

sections.title: Financial analyst agents
sections.body: Connect authorized data, extract information and prepare research, comparisons and reports with traceable sources. Your team reviews analysis and financial decisions.

sections.title: Agents inside your software
sections.body: Add agent-powered features to an existing application or a new product. Connect accounts, product data, tools and the interface people use to give instructions and review results.

sections.title: Custom Hermes and OpenClaw agents
sections.body: Set up and customize the supported agent environment around your workflows. Define models, instructions, skills, tool access, memory and deployment with a documented operator handover.

packages.title: Custom agent build
packages.body: One agent built around a defined business task, with its tools, context and review workflow.

packages.title: Agent inside an application
packages.body: An agent-powered product feature connected to the application’s accounts, data and customer journey.

process: Define the task, data, permissions and examples of a useful result.
Test the uncertain model, tool and integration behavior first.
Build the workflow with evaluation, cost limits and recovery.
Roll out the agreed scope, document operation and hand over controls.
inputs: Task examples, authorized data and tool access, account eligibility, expected volume and an operational owner for approvals and review.
boundary: Provider access, model usage, hosting and third-party subscriptions are separate. Outreach requires authorized channels and consent practices. Financial-analysis agents support review; they do not promise returns or unrestricted trading. Agent teams do not imply unlimited autonomous business operation.

name: Agent teams
title: A manager. The right specialists. One coordinated workflow.
lead: Build a team of agents that can divide a product or business workflow into jobs, share context and bring the result back for review.
audience: For product buildouts and business operations that need several kinds of work to happen together.
result: A coordinated agent team with assigned roles, shared context and a reviewed result.

sections.title: Product buildout teams
sections.body: Coordinate planning, research, coding, testing and review around your product. Give each worker a bounded task and have the manager reconcile the results.

sections.title: Business operations teams
sections.body: Connect defined research, reporting, customer operations and administrative workflows. Add the tools and approval steps appropriate to each job.

sections.title: Coordination and recovery
sections.body: Define who can assign work, how workers exchange context, when the manager escalates and what happens when a task fails or stalls.

packages.title: Manager and worker teams
packages.body: An orchestrated team for an agreed product or operating workflow.

process: Map the work and the roles it requires.
Define handoffs, shared context and permissions.
Implement the manager, workers and review workflow.
Run representative jobs and hand over operating controls.
inputs: A workflow map, representative jobs, tool access and the person responsible for approvals.
boundary: Autonomy is agreed per workflow. A team supporting business operations is not an unrestricted promise to run the entire business. Model usage and hosting are separate.

name: Agent harnesses & infrastructure
title: Build the environment your agents work in.
lead: Custom harness creation, installation and deployment for agents that need persistent execution, controlled tools and visibility into what happened.
audience: For a custom agent, an existing harness that needs deployment, or a team moving beyond a local experiment.
result: An execution environment that connects the model, tools, permissions and operating controls.

sections.title: Custom harness creation
sections.body: Build the execution loop, tool interfaces, model connections and task state around the way your agent needs to work.

sections.title: Harness installation and deployment
sections.body: Deploy a supported existing harness into the agreed environment. Connect accounts, configure access and verify operation after installation.

sections.title: Operating controls
sections.body: Add run inspection, error handling, retries, time and usage limits, approval boundaries and the controls an operator needs to manage the system.

packages.title: Agent harness and infrastructure
packages.body: Create or deploy the environment an agent or team runs inside.

process: Inspect the agent and execution requirements.
Design model, tool and permission boundaries.
Build or deploy the harness and operating controls.
Test normal runs, failures and recovery with your operator.
inputs: The current code or platform, deployment access, required tools and operating constraints.
boundary: Hosting, model usage and third-party subscriptions are listed separately. The proposal identifies the supported runtime and maintenance responsibility.

name: Jev implementation
title: Give your agent a structured decision layer.
lead: Integrate TypeSafe AI’s Jev into routing, classification and evaluation. The result feeds a defined branch in your application or agent harness.
audience: For teams choosing a model, classifying requests, reviewing agent output or deciding when a workflow needs escalation.
result: A tested Jev integration for a specific decision in your system.

sections.title: Model and task routing
sections.body: Classify an incoming task and use the result to select the next model, worker or workflow branch.

sections.title: Classification and prioritization
sections.body: Turn context into typed decisions your software can act on, such as request category, priority or whether a review is needed.

sections.title: Agent evaluation
sections.body: Apply defined criteria to agent output or traces. Compare the decisions with reviewed examples before using the results to control a workflow.

sections.title: Thresholds and fallback
sections.body: Define how confidence affects the next action and what happens when the result is uncertain or the provider is unavailable.

packages.title: Jev decision integration
packages.body: One defined decision, its application connection and a representative evaluation set.

process: Choose the decision and define the possible results.
Prepare examples and review the expected decisions.
Connect Jev and implement thresholds and fallback paths.
Evaluate the integration and document the operating tradeoffs.
inputs: Representative inputs, expected decisions, application access and a TypeSafe AI account with the required access.
boundary: Jev returns structured decisions rather than generated text or media. We measure suitability on your examples; vendor speed and cost claims are not a project guarantee.

name: Context systems & memory
title: Give agents the information they need to do the job.
lead: Build context storage, vector databases and retrieval around your business sources, with control over what stays current and who can access it.
audience: For agents that lose useful context, cannot find internal information or rely on repeated manual briefings.
result: A connected context and memory system that agents can retrieve from and update as agreed.

sections.title: Context systems
sections.body: Organize the instructions, business knowledge and task state that should inform an agent’s work. Separate durable knowledge from temporary task context.

sections.title: Vector databases and retrieval
sections.body: Create the database, ingestion and search connection for the agreed sources. Test whether the right information is retrieved for representative questions.

sections.title: Agent context storage
sections.body: Install persistent storage for selected context and memory. Define updates, deletion, retention and who is allowed to read or write.

packages.title: Context and memory system
packages.body: Business sources, ingestion, retrieval and persistent agent context.

process: Inventory sources and agent information needs.
Design storage, retrieval and access rules.
Connect ingestion and the agent’s context tools.
Test retrieval, updates and access with representative tasks.
inputs: Authorized sources, source owners, representative questions and data retention requirements.
boundary: Storage, embedding and model usage costs are separate. Source access and the permitted uses of data must be agreed.

name: MCP, APIs & AI integrations
title: Connect the tools. Build the missing interfaces.
lead: Install existing MCP connections, create custom MCP servers and APIs, and connect AI workflows to the applications and data they need.
audience: For a missing integration, a private business tool that needs an agent interface, or a product that needs its own API.
result: A working, documented connection between your agent or application and the required system.

sections.title: MCP installation and integration
sections.body: Configure an existing supported MCP server, connect it to the intended client and verify the tools against real permitted tasks.

sections.title: Custom MCP creation
sections.body: Expose your business systems through purpose-built tools. Define inputs, outputs, authentication and the actions each agent is allowed to perform.

sections.title: Custom API creation
sections.body: Build endpoints for your product or business workflow, including validation, authorization, data handling and documentation.

sections.title: AI tools inside applications
sections.body: Connect model and agent capabilities to product accounts, interfaces and existing workflows. Define how results are returned and failures reach the user.

packages.title: MCP integration
packages.body: Connect and verify an existing supported server.

packages.title: Custom MCP server
packages.body: Create a tool interface for your private system.

packages.title: Custom API
packages.body: Build and document application endpoints.

packages.title: AI tool integration
packages.body: Connect an agent or model to a product workflow.

process: Define the systems, actions and data to connect.
Agree contracts, authentication and permissions.
Implement and deploy the interface.
Test permitted actions, denied access and failure behavior.
inputs: System documentation, authorized accounts, sample data and access requirements.
boundary: Third-party API access, limits and fees depend on the provider. The proposal identifies supported operations and maintenance responsibility.

name: Image, video & audio workflows
title: From a creative brief to a repeatable production workflow.
lead: Build generation agents and connected workflows for images, video and audio, including Seedance and ElevenLabs where the required access is available.
audience: For teams turning repeated creative production into a controlled process inside their own tools.
result: A workflow that takes approved inputs through generation, review and delivery.

sections.title: Image generation workflows
sections.body: Connect brand context, product references, generation, review and export. Define the formats and checks that make an asset usable in its intended placement.

sections.title: Video workflows
sections.body: Integrate supported video models, including Seedance where available, into the brief, generation and review process. Handle jobs, status and output delivery.

sections.title: Audio and voice workflows
sections.body: Connect supported audio tools such as ElevenLabs to the agreed voice or audio production workflow, with approved inputs and delivery formats.

sections.title: Applied creative agents
sections.body: Build agents that prepare inputs, call the selected models and organize outputs inside an application or business system. Final review remains part of the production workflow.

packages.title: Creative model workflow
packages.body: Image, video or audio production connected to review and delivery.

packages.title: Creative generation agent
packages.body: A custom agent that operates the agreed production workflow.

process: Define the outputs, references and intended placements.
Test available models against representative creative briefs.
Connect generation, review and delivery in the workflow.
Run a complete production example and hand over controls.
inputs: Approved brand assets and references, output specifications, account access and a creative reviewer.
boundary: Model access, usage fees and content rights are checked during scoping. This is a workflow implementation offer; ongoing content production is a separate scope.

name: AI setup & consulting
title: Put the tools you chose to work in your business.
lead: Setup, configuration and consultation for custom Hermes agents, OpenClaw, ChatGPT / ChatGPT Work, Claude and Claude Code.
audience: For an individual, team or business adopting an AI tool or repairing a setup that is not working.
result: A configured environment, connected workflow and practical handover for the people using it.

sections.title: Hermes and OpenClaw
sections.body: Configure the selected agent environment, models, instructions, skills and tool access. Customize it for the workflow you want to run.

sections.title: ChatGPT / ChatGPT Work
sections.body: Scope the available workspace, account configuration, knowledge, tool connections and working practices. Hosted setup is distinguished from custom API development.

sections.title: Claude and Claude Code
sections.body: Configure supported product access and the relevant document or coding workflow. For coding use, include repository instructions, development tools and review practices.

sections.title: Grokbot setup and consultation
sections.body: Review the exact Grokbot product and deployment you mean, then define the supported installation, configuration or consulting scope. We verify product identity and access before quoting.

packages.title: Platform and agent setup
packages.body: Configure the selected supported AI environment and hand it over.

packages.title: AI adoption consultation
packages.body: Choose tools and workflows, diagnose setup issues and plan implementation.

process: Identify the exact product, account and intended workflow.
Review access, permissions and setup requirements.
Install or configure the supported environment.
Walk through representative tasks and hand over guidance.
inputs: The exact product, authorized account access, devices or workspace and target workflows.
boundary: Provider subscriptions and eligibility are separate. Setup means the supported installation or hosted configuration path for the selected product.

name: Brand creation & implementation
title: A clear identity, carried through every detail.
lead: We create brand kits and implement them across websites, products and ecommerce. The work covers the identity and the practical assets your team needs to use it consistently.
audience: For a new business, product or store, and for teams whose existing brand is inconsistent across their digital experience.
result: A usable brand system with the agreed source files, guidelines, templates and implementation scope.

sections.title: Direction and identity
sections.body: Clarify the audience, positioning and visual direction. Develop the agreed identity assets, including the logo treatment, typography, color and image direction.

sections.title: A working brand kit
sections.body: Reusable design assets, practical usage guidance and templates for the channels in scope. The kit should be useful to the people creating your next page, product or campaign.

sections.title: Product labels and packaging
sections.body: Label design and packaging artwork using approved product facts, dimensions and printer specifications. Proofing and specialist regulatory requirements are agreed separately.

sections.title: Digital implementation
sections.body: Apply the brand to the website, ecommerce store or software interface. We inspect typography, imagery, layout and key customer journeys together.

sections.title: Content and imagery
sections.body: Define an image and copy treatment suited to the business. Original asset creation and revisions are scoped against a clear inventory rather than an unlimited creative promise.

packages.title: Custom brand kit
packages.body: Create the identity assets and guidance needed for a defined launch or refresh.

packages.title: Brand implementation
packages.body: Apply an existing or new system across agreed digital surfaces.

packages.title: Product and brand launch
packages.body: Connect ecommerce identity, product labels and launch assets.

process: Review the business, audience and existing assets.
Agree the direction through representative applications.
Develop the kit and implement the scoped surfaces.
Check consistency and hand over the files and usage guidance.
inputs: Business and audience context, existing marks, approved names and copy, required channels, asset inventory and any printer specifications.
boundary: Trademark clearance, legal claims review, printing and third-party licenses are separate. Deliverables and revision rounds are agreed before production.

name: Unslop
title: Unslop your website. Unslop your content.
lead: Bring us the work that is close but does not hold together. We repair the generic design, inconsistent branding, vague copy and broken journeys within a defined scope.
audience: For businesses with an AI-generated site, prototype or body of content that needs experienced design, editorial and development attention.
result: Revised work that reflects your business, with the agreed functional checks and a clear account of what changed.

sections.title: Inspect before replacing
sections.body: We review the actual pages, copy, code and customer journeys. The first decision is what to preserve, what to repair and whether any part needs a rebuild.

sections.title: Website repair
sections.body: Information structure, typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, brand consistency, mobile layouts, forms and connected journeys. The work is scoped around observable defects and the intended experience.

sections.title: Content repair
sections.body: Rewrite generic or repetitive website and business copy for a defined audience. Improve structure, terminology and specificity while preserving your facts, conditions and voice.

sections.title: Claims and factual questions
sections.body: Identify statements that need evidence, qualification or removal. We do not invent customer stories, authority signals or results to make the work more persuasive.

sections.title: Representative correction
sections.body: Establish the direction on a meaningful part of the work before applying it more widely. Inspect the result in its actual context, then complete the remaining agreed scope.

packages.title: Unslop your website
packages.body: A scoped design, content and functional repair of an inspected website.

packages.title: Unslop your content
packages.body: Editorial repair of an agreed set of pages or documents, with factual questions retained.

process: Inspect the existing work and record what needs attention.
Agree a repair scope and a representative correction.
Complete the design, writing and development changes.
Recheck affected journeys and hand over the revised work.
inputs: The current site or documents, source access where relevant, brand references, approved business facts and one reviewer who can resolve factual questions.
boundary: New branding, major backend replacement, original research and additional integrations are separate scopes. We do not promise AI-detector scores, search rankings or revenue outcomes.

name: Consultation
title: A clear recommendation for your next decision.
lead: Bring a website, store, product or AI system. We help diagnose the problem, compare practical options and turn the decision into a written plan you can use.
audience: For founders, business owners and teams deciding what to build, what to fix, which platform to choose or how to implement a new capability.
result: A written assessment, relevant tradeoffs and prioritized next steps. You can act on the recommendation with Fortitudo, your own team or another provider.

sections.title: Strategy and implementation planning
sections.body: Translate a business objective into practical scope, milestones, dependencies and decisions. Consultation spans every service in this catalog.

sections.title: Diagnosis and troubleshooting
sections.body: Inspect a website, application, agent or integration that is not behaving as expected. Separate the demonstrated failure from assumptions and recommend the next useful action.

sections.title: Architecture and platform choices
sections.body: Compare technical approaches, vendors, data models and operating responsibilities. Explain the implications for cost, delivery, ownership and maintainability.

sections.title: Product and experience review
sections.body: Review the structure, interface, content and customer journeys of an existing product or proposed build. Identify specific corrections rather than returning a generic score.

sections.title: AI and workflow enablement
sections.body: Plan or review agent platforms, harnesses, teams, context systems, model workflows, MCP and API integrations, including setup guidance for supported tools.

sections.title: Proposal and delivery review
sections.body: Assess another supplier's scope or your current delivery plan. Document unanswered questions, dependencies and acceptance criteria before the next commitment.

packages.title: A defined consultation engagement
packages.body: Choose strategy, diagnosis, architecture, product review, enablement or proposal review. Scope the question and written output before work starts.

process: Agree the decision and the questions the engagement must answer.
Inspect the relevant system, documents and constraints.
Compare options and discuss the implications with your team.
Deliver the assessment and an actionable next-step plan.
inputs: The question or problem, relevant links and documents, access needed for inspection, known constraints and the people responsible for the decision.
boundary: Detailed reviews are separately scoped work. Implementation, specialist legal advice, formal certification and ongoing operational responsibility are not implied by a consultation.
